```{r}
# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load the CSV
df <- read_csv("data/group4/filtered_data_group4.csv")
```

## Create summarized version
```{r}
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Participant_id, is_val) %>%
  summarise(Test_Score = mean(Test_Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = is_val, values_from = Test_Score,
              names_prefix = "Choice_") %>%
  rename(Forced_Choice_Mean = Choice_0,
         Free_Choice_Score = Choice_1) %>%
  drop_na()  
```

## Paired t-test: Free vs Forced
```{r}
# Paired t-test
t_test_result <- t.test(summary_df$Free_Choice_Score,
                        summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean,
                        paired = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Mean (Free Choice): %.2f\n", mean(summary_df$Free_Choice_Score)))
cat(sprintf("Mean (Forced Choice): %.2f\n", mean(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean)))
cat(sprintf("Paired t-test: t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            t_test_result$statistic,
            t_test_result$p.value))
```

## Compute means and standard deviations
```{r}
free_mean <- mean(summary_df$Free_Choice_Score)
free_sd <- sd(summary_df$Free_Choice_Score)

forced_mean <- mean(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean)
forced_sd <- sd(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean)

cat(sprintf("Free Choice — Mean: %.2f, SD: %.2f\n", free_mean, free_sd))
cat(sprintf("Forced Choice — Mean: %.2f, SD: %.2f\n", forced_mean, forced_sd))
```

## Count participants showing correspondence bias (≥90%)
```{r}
num_correspondence_bias <- sum(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean >= 90)
total_participants <- nrow(summary_df)

cat(sprintf("Participants showing correspondence bias (≥90%%): %d / %d\n",
            num_correspondence_bias, total_participants))

```

## One-sample t-test on Forced Choice against 50%
```{r}
# One-sample t-test
t_test_one_sample <- t.test(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean, mu = 50)

n <- nrow(summary_df)
mean_forced <- mean(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean)
sd_forced <- sd(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean)

cat(sprintf("One-sample t-test against 50%%: t(%d) = %.2f, p = %.4e\n",
            n - 1, t_test_one_sample$statistic, t_test_one_sample$p.value))
cat(sprintf("Mean: %.2f%%, SD: %.2f%%, N = %d\n",
            mean_forced, sd_forced, n))
```

## Plots
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

panel_a_data <- data.frame(
  condition = c("Free", "Forced"),
  mean = c(mean(summary_df$Free_Choice_Score),
           mean(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean)),
  se = c(sd(summary_df$Free_Choice_Score) / sqrt(nrow(summary_df)),
         sd(summary_df$Forced_Choice_Mean) / sqrt(nrow(summary_df)))
)
panel_a_data$condition <- factor(panel_a_data$condition, levels = c("Free", "Forced"))

color_palette <- c("Free" = "#7B3294", "Forced" = "#E66101")

# ---- Plot A: Bar plot with black error bars and larger text ----
plot_a <- ggplot(panel_a_data, aes(x = condition, y = mean, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                width = 0.2, size = 0.75, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    x = "\nCondition",
    y = "Mean Preference Rating (%)\n",
    title = "A. Mean Preference Ratings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold")
  )

# ---- Plot B: Free Choice Distribution ----
# ---- Plot B: Free Choice Distribution ----
plot_b <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Free_Choice_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 binwidth = 5, center = 50,
                 fill = color_palette["Free"], color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "\nScore",
    y = "\nProportion\n",
    title = "B. Free Choice Distribution"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold")
  )

# ---- Plot C: Forced Choice Distribution ----
plot_c <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Forced_Choice_Mean)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 binwidth = 5, center = 50,
                 fill = color_palette["Forced"], color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "\nMean Score",
    y = "\nProportion\n",
    title = "C. Forced Choice Distribution"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold")
  )

# ---- Combine and Save ----
final_plot <- plot_a + plot_b + plot_c + plot_layout(ncol = 3)

ggsave("plots/study1_results_bar_version.png", final_plot, width = 13, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```
